journey.name: Start a workout
journey.description: Edit the next workout's work time, start it, pause and resume, skip ahead, then end it before any round is finished. Then start one again and leave it running while Android destroys the app's screen ("Don't keep activities"), pause it from the lock screen, and swipe the app away. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Tap the "Train" tab, tap "Conditioning", then tap "Timer" at the top of the presets, and verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button
Tap the "Work" row under "Intervals"
Verify that a sheet titled "Work" is shown with "Quick picks"
Tap the "1:00" quick pick
Tap "Done"
Verify that the "Work" row shows 1:00
Tap "Start workout"
Verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready" and a countdown clock
Press Home and verify that the status bar shows a chip with the workout's clock (Android 16+)
Verify with adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact that the workout's notification has PROMOTED_ONGOING among its flags and android.progressMax is the workout's length in seconds
Pull down the shade and verify that the notification shows a bar under "Get ready" or "Work" and the round, with "Pause" and "End"
Tap "Pause" in the notification and verify that it reads "Paused"
Tap the notification to return to the workout
Verify that the screen shows "Paused" and a "Resume" button
Tap "Resume"
Verify that the screen shows a "Pause" button
Tap "Skip"
Verify that the screen moves to the next interval with "Round 1 of 8": "Work" if Get ready was still on, else "Rest"
Tap "End"
Verify that a dialog titled "End workout?" says nothing is saved
Tap "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that the Timer is shown with a "Start workout" button
In Developer options, turn on "Don't keep activities" (adb shell settings put global always_finish_activities 1 alone doesn't reach the activity manager on API 37)
Tap "Start workout" and verify that the workout screen shows "Get ready"
Press Home, wait 15 seconds, and verify with adb shell dumpsys activity activities that no dev.justinsmith.interval activity is left, while the workout's notification still counts down
Tap the notification and verify that the workout screen shows the same workout, past "Get ready" and still counting
Turn "Don't keep activities" off again
With a screen lock set, lock the screen (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP, then KEYCODE_WAKEUP) and verify that the lock screen shows the workout's notification
Tap "Pause" in the notification on the lock screen and verify that it reads "Paused"
Unlock, open Recents and swipe the app away
Verify with adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact that no workout notification is left, and that opening the app shows Today
